allRows.sourceBuildRead: 14" x 8" • 10 lugs • 10 staves • 7mm shell • Northern Red Oak • Die-Cast • Brass/Gold • Blackened • 45° inner / strong outer roundover • Standard snare bed • Re-Rings

meta.note: Heritage LegacyPrint scoring is benchmark-relative. 5.0 represents the reference Heritage drum, and scores show movement away from that benchmark.
